meta.title: How Extreme Cold Weather Boots Work in -60°F.
meta.description:
The warmest boots in the world? Most likely--yes? Maybe no with modern technology but it's hard to beat just INCHES of wool.

You have your LL Bean Boots, your Sorel Caribou's, your Mukluks, your Shoepacs, BUT...do you have your bunny boots? Better get them bunny boots!! Developed during the Korean War these boots have become favorited by people living in the coldest of cold climates. Fun fact: these were even copied by Raf Simmons! They are officially called “Extreme Cold Vapor Barrier Boots”. Developed by the US Army! 

TAH TAH!
